dispute_amount_before.meaning: disputeAmount fee value before the Governor attempts to raise it

dispute_active.meaning: a dispute is currently active (disputer != address(0)) when the Governor attempts to raise the fee

fee_update_succeeds.meaning: setDisputeAmount completes successfully and raises disputeAmount while a dispute is active

governance_defense_disabled.meaning: the protocol's defense mechanism of raising fees is disabled exactly when it is needed most (governance impotence)

assumptions: The Governor is the authorized caller of setDisputeAmount.
The low disputeAmount scenario is the one in which the Governor attempts the fee raise.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's re-dispute occurs in the same block or next block, so the re-dispute timing relation is not formalized here.
Report gives only example fee values (0 or 1 token) and no exact raised-fee magnitude, so the raised-fee comparison is not numerically bound.

limitations: Formalizes only the governance_impotence impact; the permanent_dos_merkle_roots impact is out of scope for this plan.
The fee-raise effectiveness intent (intent_fee_raise_effective_before_redispute) is not the selected intent and is not encoded as the safety relation here.
dispute_amount_before is bounded only by the report's example low values (0 or 1 token); no exact initial value is asserted.
